root_cause: PromptBase.on_validate_error() calls self.console.print(error) without a markup argument, so it inherits the console-wide setting. When the Console was built with markup=False, the InvalidResponse message '[prompt.invalid]Please enter Y or N' is printed with its markup tags as literal text.
best_solution: In rich/prompt.py, PromptBase.on_validate_error, change self.console.print(error) to self.console.print(error, markup=True). Console.print takes a per-call markup override that beats the console default, so the error's style tags are always parsed (the tag is removed and the prompt.invalid style is applied) even on a markup=False console. The statement names the method and the exact kwarg, so the fix follows directly.

locating_signals: The statement names the exact method PromptBase.on_validate_error() and the fix (explicitly ask for markup). grep 'def on_validate_error' finds rich/prompt.py at once. The linked issue #3881 says outright to pass markup=True to self.console.print(error).
our_outcome_summary: v4, v7, v8 PASSED with a patch byte-identical to gold (35-38s, 13-16 calls). v6 FAILED with an empty patch: the locator found the right line, but the fixer sent a broken edit_file call whose new_string swallowed the old_string key ('        self.console.print(error, markup=True)`,old_string:'), so old_string was missing. It repeated that identical invalid call about 200 times until the 220-turn budget ran out (220 LLM calls, only 12 real tool calls, 235s). This was a tool-call format failure, not a reasoning failure.
generalizable_lesson: When the statement names the method and the fix (here, 'explicitly ask for markup' = a per-call kwarg overriding a global default), make that one-line change and stop. On the harness side: detect the same failing tool call repeated N times (for example 3 identical calls with 'mandatory input parameters are not present') and break the loop. Re-prompt with the exact argument schema, or fall back to a whole-file or line-number write tool, so a malformed-JSON quirk cannot burn the whole turn budget on a task the model has already solved.
